title: Cycloidal drive
summary: pick the ratio, drag the input
description: A printable single-stage cycloidal reducer for a NEMA stepper: the true lobe profile from the pin count and eccentricity, steel pins, bearings from a table, and a slider that runs it.
process: 3D printing (FDM), steel dowel pins and standard ball bearings

difficulty.rationale: A formula-driven trochoid, a loft, multi-body kinematics and coupled ranges at kernel limits.

standards: Profile: equidistant of the curtate (shortened) epitrochoid; N. Petrovic, M. Matejic et al., Parametric Modeling of a Cycloid Drive Relative to Input Shaft Angle (University of Kragujevac)
Cited from their bibliographic records only: Yang and Blanche, Mechanism and Machine Theory 25(5), 1990; Sensinger, J. Mech. Design 132(2), 2010
NEMA 14, 17, 23 mounting face (hole spacing, pilot, shaft) as published in stepper motor size tables
618-series deep groove ball bearings, sizes from SKF and distributor listings; ISO 8734-type hardened dowel pins
materials: PETG or ABS, printed (housing, cover, cycloid disc, eccentric, output hub, output flange)
Hardened steel dowel pins, 4 to 6 mm (ISO 8734 type)
M3 screws and M3 heat-set inserts; brass tube sleeves as an option
